0 - OLD FORGE
1 - FISH CREEK/REMSEN
2 - PLATTSBURGH
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
day1 <- read.csv("day1.csv") |> filter(year > 2007)
day2 <- read.csv("day2.csv") |> filter(year > 2007)
day3 <- read.csv("day3.csv") |> filter(year > 2007)
weather <- read.csv("weather.csv")
water <- read.csv("water_level.csv")
dates <- read.csv("dates.csv")

dates <- dates |> select(day.1, day.2, day.3) |>
  mutate(day.1 = mdy(day.1), day.2 = mdy(day.2), day.3 = mdy(day.3))

weather <- weather |> mutate(time = ymd(time))
```

```{r}
day1_weather <- weather |> filter(time %in% dates$day.1 & location_id == 0) |>
  mutate(time = year(time))

day2_weather <- weather |> filter(time %in% dates$day.2 & location_id == 1) |>
  mutate(time = year(time))

day3_weather <- weather |> filter(time %in% dates$day.3 & location_id == 2) |>
  mutate(time = year(time))
```

```{r}
day1 <- left_join(day1, day1_weather, join_by(year == time))
day2 <- left_join(day2, day2_weather, join_by(year == time))
day3 <- left_join(day3, day3_weather, join_by(year == time))
```

```{r}
day1_full <- left_join(day1, water) |> select(!location_id & !day2 & !day3)
day2_full <- left_join(day2, water) |> select(!location_id & !day1 & !day3)
day3_full <- left_join(day3, water) |> select(!location_id & !day1 & !day2)
```

```{r}
day1_full <- day1_full |> 
  rename(temp = temperature_2m_mean...F.) |>
  rename(rain = precipitation_sum..inch.) |>
  rename(water = day1)

day2_full <- day2_full |> 
  rename(temp = temperature_2m_mean...F.) |>
  rename(rain = precipitation_sum..inch.) |>
  rename(water = day2)

day3_full <- day3_full |> 
  rename(temp = temperature_2m_mean...F.) |>
  rename(rain = precipitation_sum..inch.) |>
  rename(water = day3)

library(broom)
mod1 <- lm(value ~ boatType + water + temp + rain, day3_full)

summary(mod1)
```

```{r}
write_csv(day1_full, "day1_full.csv")
write_csv(day2_full, "day2_full.csv")
write_csv(day3_full, "day3_full.csv")
```
